items.title: How does scope scale with a bug's actual reach?
items.description: This is a simplified teaching model. Exposure means money at risk if the bug reaches customers. Scope is the possible reach; impact is that reach adjusted by how likely the bad outcome is.

params.name: likelihoodPercent
params.label: Likelihood the bad charge would happen

items.compute: const totalExposure = params.customersAffected * params.chargePerCustomer; const expectedPreventedImpact = Math.round(totalExposure * (params.likelihoodPercent / 100)); return { totalExposure, expectedPreventedImpact };
